zf = zipfile.ZipFile(realm_path)
prefix = 'assets/realms/textures/gui/realms/'
BLACKLIST = {'no_realms.png', 'snapshot_realms.png'}
dst = out_root / 'realms'
dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
n = 0
for name in zf.namelist():
    if name.endswith('/') or not name.startswith(prefix):
        continue
    rel = name[len(prefix):]
    if '/' in rel or rel in BLACKLIST:
        continue
    out = dst / rel
    with zf.open(name) as s, open(out, 'wb') as d:
        shutil.copyfileobj(s, d)
    n += 1
log('realm icons: ' + str(n), 'OK')

import subprocess
src_dir = out_root / 'realms'
dst = out_root / 'icon'
dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

trial = src_dir / 'trial_icon.png'
subprocess.run(['magick', str(trial), '-crop', '8x8+0+0', '+repage', str(dst / 'realms_trial_b.png')], check=True)
subprocess.run(['magick', str(trial), '-crop', '8x8+0+8', '+repage', str(dst / 'realms_trial_a.png')], check=True)
(dst / 'realms_trial_a.png').rename(dst / 'realms_trial_on.png')
(dst / 'realms_trial_b.png').rename(dst / 'realms_trial_off.png')

inv = src_dir / 'invite_icon.png'
subprocess.run(['magick', str(inv), '-crop', '15x25+0+0',  '+repage', str(dst / 'realms_invite_on.png')],  check=True)
subprocess.run(['magick', str(inv), '-crop', '16x25+15+0', '+repage', str(dst / 'realms_invite_off.png')], check=True)

log('icon slice done', 'OK')

zs = None
h = index.get('minecraft/resourcepacks/high_contrast.zip')
if h:
    p = assets_root / 'objects' / h[:2] / h
    if p.exists(): zs = p
if zs is None:
    p = assets_root / 'minecraft' / 'resourcepacks' / 'high_contrast.zip'
    if p.exists(): zs = p
if zs is None:
    log('high_contrast.zip 未找到', 'WARN')
else:
    (out_root / 'resourcepacks').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zs) as z:
        with z.open('pack.png') as s, open(out_root / 'resourcepacks' / 'high_contrast-pack.png', 'wb') as d:
            shutil.copyfileobj(s, d)
    log('high_contrast pack.png', 'OK')

import subprocess
with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as z:
    for name, size in [('minecraft', '256x64'), ('minceraft', '256x64'), ('edition', '128x16')]:
        inner = 'assets/minecraft/textures/gui/title/' + name + '.png'
        try:
            with z.open(inner) as s:
                data = s.read()
        except KeyError:
            log('logo 缺失: ' + inner, 'WARN')
            continue
        tmp = out_root / 'logo' / (name + '.png')
        tmp.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        dst = out_root / 'logo' / (name + '_small.png')
        subprocess.run(['magick', str(tmp), '-resize', size + '!', str(dst)], check=True)
        tmp.unlink()
        log('logo ' + name + '_small.png', 'OK')

import subprocess
sizes = [20, 44, 70, 71, 80, 83, 85, 90, 95, 97, 98, 100, 106, 120, 150, 153, 160, 170, 205, 210, 310]
mc = out_root.parent / 'mcslice.sh'
for w in sizes:
    for base in ['button', 'button_highlighted', 'button_disabled']:
        src = out_root / 'button' / (base + '.png')
        dst = out_root / 'button' / (base + '_' + str(w) + '.png')
        subprocess.run(['bash', str(mc), str(src), str(dst), str(w), '20', '3'], check=True)
log('button slices done', 'OK')

import subprocess
for base in ['slider', 'slider_highlighted']:
    src = out_root / 'slider' / (base + '.png')
    for w in [170, 310]:
        dst = out_root / 'slider' / (base + '_' + str(w) + '.png')
        subprocess.run(['magick', 'convert', str(src), '-resize', str(w) + 'x20!', str(dst)], check=True)
log('slider variants done', 'OK')
